notes.title: Adjust the control panel, the robot's AI
notes.content:
Based on the player’s enthusiastic feedback, the following corrections have been made:

Modify the robot's AI to keep it alert within a certain range and weaken the robot's attack power
Fixed the problem that the repair button of the current viewport could not repair the buff tower
Add a volume control button to the settings panel

notes.title: Correct the operation and value of the character
notes.content:
Based on the enthusiastic feedback of some players, the values related to the operation experience and role roles have been changed
So that the Buff Tower can be repaired and sold
The generation of gold coins is now automatically collected, no need to manually click
Increased the crawler's movement speed to 1.5 times
The range of the curved gun has been increased, and the pre-judgment function of the curved gun for mobile units has been removed
The HP of basic defense units, machine guns and curved cannons has been greatly increased, especially the HP of machine guns has been increased to 5500, which can reach 9000 after the upgrade, so that it can effectively face the swarms of insects.
Significantly increase the range of the biped mecha while reducing its output speed
Optimized the problem that the Buff tower would sometimes only add a Buff to one tower. Because the energy beam has a time of 1.3 seconds to arrive, there may be a problem of multiple buff towers targeting the same building during this period.
Added language options in the settings panel

notes.title: Corrected pathfinding AI
notes.content: Enthusiastic players have reported that the current ground mechas sometimes get stuck in blind spots and cannot move. The pathfinding algorithm has been corrected to prevent ground mechas from getting stuck in blind spots.

notes.title: Melee Hero: Iron Guard
notes.content:
Some players previously reported that in the later stages of the game, a large number of gold coin resources could not be used effectively.

Therefore, a summoning skill has been added to the fort, which can summon a melee robot hero: Iron Guard. The iron guard has high health, high armor, and the basic damage is range damage. It can release a fan-shaped shield, and it can also release a gain range buff to strengthen the armor and attack power of surrounding units.

notes.title: Correct the AI of the aircraft
notes.content:
The bug generated by this AI will cause the aircraft to take off again after landing, which will cause the operation to become unresponsive
The bug that controls the take-off and landing of the aircraft has been corrected

Thank the players for their enthusiastic feedback and provide video evidence

notes.title: Reworked the main city
notes.content:
The main city has been modified and a character library has been added so that players can preview all the characters (towers, tanks, aircraft, etc.), their main functions and attributes.
All characters can be demonstrated in the main city.

notes.title: Fix bugs reported by players
notes.content:
Some players said that during the game, there was a problem of sudden inoperability. After debugging, this problem does exist.
The root cause of the problem has been found: it is the abnormal termination of the Buff special effect, causing the game to function abnormally.
This bug has been corrected.
Thank you players for your enthusiastic feedback. And provide video evidence

notes.title: Role data display
notes.content: Added a detailed description of the character, the attack range of the character is automatically displayed without the shortcut key operation (for the introduction of the screen, the attack range will automatically disappear after displaying for a period of time, so the original shortcut key Z is still retained)
